# Strip surrounding whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    if not text:
        raise ValueError("empty duration string")

    # If the text is a plain integer, interpret as seconds
    if text.isdigit():
        return int(text)

    # Mapping of unit to its multiplier and order index
    unit_map = {suffix: (size, idx) for idx, (suffix, size) in enumerate(_UNITS)}
    # also allow uppercase
    unit_map.update({suffix.upper(): (size, idx) for suffix, (size, idx) in [(u, (s, i)) for i, (u, s) in enumerate(_UNITS)]})

    total_seconds = 0
    seen_units = set()
    last_order = -1
    i = 0
    n = len(text)
    while i < n:
        # skip spaces
        while i < n and text[i].isspace():
            i += 1
        if i >= n:
            break
        # parse number
        start_num = i
        while i < n and text[i].isdigit():
            i += 1
        if start_num == i:
            raise ValueError(f"expected number at position {start_num}")
        number = int(text[start_num:i])
        # after number, there must be a unit character
        if i >= n:
            raise ValueError("missing unit after number")
        unit_char = text[i]
        i += 1
        if unit_char not in unit_map:
            raise ValueError(f"unknown unit '{unit_char}'")
        size, order = unit_map[unit_char]
        # enforce order and uniqueness
        if order < last_order:
            raise ValueError("units out of order")
        if unit_char.lower() in seen_units:
            raise ValueError("duplicate unit")
        seen_units.add(unit_char.lower())
        last_order = order
        total_seconds += number * size
        # continue loop, whitespace will be skipped automatically
    return total_seconds
